units.source_text: 她想起了小野篁朝臣咏“比良山上木绵白……”之诗时的雪晨景象，

en.t: She remembered the snowy morning scene evoked in the poem Courtier Ono no Takamura had composed, "On Mount Hira, the yufu cloth is white..."

units.source_text: 觉得今夜的严霜正是神明容受源氏主君供养的证验，

en.t: and felt that tonight's heavy frost was proof that the gods had accepted Lord Genji's offering.
She rejoiced all the more that this journey had not been in vain.
